Resolves #20599

On a portrait phone, the news section's left-docked tab bar clipped its last tabs: at 390×664, Pull Requests and the new Videos tab could not be reached. The portal's shared tab container now enables the engine's `Neo.tab.plugin.Overflow`. Headers that exceed the bar's height collapse behind one ⋮ control whose menu reaches them, and a desktop viewport is unchanged. A tab chosen from that menu now also updates the route the way its header would: a plain route replaces the hash, and an `editRoute` header merges its fields into it.

Evidence: L3 (Chromium e2e on phone and desktop viewports against the dev server, red on base and green at head) → L3 required (AC-1 to AC-4 are browser behaviors). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/e2e/portal/NewsTabOverflow.spec.mjs` — `every news tab stays reachable at 390×664, and a tab chosen from the menu moves the route` and `every news tab stays reachable at 320×568` |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: same spec — `both section bars withdraw the control once a desktop viewport fits every header` (news arm; all seven headers then reachable from the bar) |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: same test — its `#/examples` arm |
| AC-4 | Outside-CI: red on base, see Test Evidence; green at head in the e2e tier |

## Deltas from ticket
- **Engine half, needed for AC-1:** with the plugin alone, choosing Videos from the menu switched the content but left the URL at `#/news/releases/13.3.1`. `Neo.tab.plugin.Overflow` now carries each hidden button's route policy into its menu item. A plain `route` goes on the record, and `Neo.menu.List` navigates it after its handler (`src/menu/List.mjs`). An `editRoute: true` header's item merges through `Neo.Main.editRoute` and hands the record no route, so nothing overwrites the hash afterwards (Euclid's review RA-1). Tabs without a route, such as the dashboard dock's, keep the `activeIndex`-only selection. `test/playwright/unit/tab/plugin/Overflow.spec.mjs` witnesses all three policies, and `test/playwright/component/tab/OverflowRoute.spec.mjs` witnesses the merge in a browser.
- **`headerToolbar` moved into `Portal.view.shared.TabContainer`:** both subclasses repeated the same `{cls}` block, and `tab.Container#headerToolbar` is a plain config, so a subclass value would replace the plugin. Both copies are deleted. Each toolbar's reactive `plugins_` setter deep-clones the shared default before instantiating it (`src/Neo.mjs` generated setter), so the two bars never share a plugin instance.
- No public config, method or event changes, so no Contract Ledger is needed. #20599's Fix section records both points.

## Test Evidence
Diagonal runs outside CI, against the dev server in headless Chromium, with each probe swap made by `git checkout origin/dev -- <path>` and restored afterwards:
- **All four source files at base `d17300f00f`:** `NewsTabOverflow.spec.mjs` fails 3/3, because the control never appears.
- **Portal fix with base `src/tab/plugin/Overflow.mjs`:** the 390×664 test fails at `toHaveURL`, receiving `#/news/releases/13.3.1`. This isolates the engine half.
- **Unit route test with base `Overflow.mjs`:** fails.
- **`editRoute` arm with the previous head `f72ba776d6`'s `Overflow.mjs`:** `OverflowRoute.spec.mjs` fails, receiving `#mainview=table` instead of `#country=DE&mainview=table`, and the unit policy test fails too.

`agent-preflight`: not hosted here; the PR baseline runs.

## Post-Merge Validation
None required: the e2e spec witnesses the browser behavior before merge.

- `f72ba776d6`: the shared portal tab container enables the plugin, the duplicated toolbar config moves up, and the e2e spec is added
